name: nvjpeg_ycbcr_to_rgb_444
desc: nvjpeg::ycbcr_to_format_kernel_roi<444(0), false, RGB(3), LaunchParams<32,8>> from libnvjpeg sm_90. Planar YCbCr 4:4:4 -> planar RGB. Identical FFMA conversion math to the 4:2:0 RGB variant; the ONLY difference is the chroma index: for subsamp=0 (4:4:4) the SASS uses chroma at FULL resolution (Cb=ch1[r*pCb+c], Cr=ch2[r*pCr+c]) with NO `LEA.HI;SHF.R 0x1` halving (verified absent vs the 4:2:0 kernel which has it). Output uint8 from FP; compared with +/-1 TOLERANCE (cmp_u8_tol).
ground_truth: x86-lifted vs host fmaf reference, +/-1 tol: 0/384, TEST PASSED
